question: Calculate: \(20 \div 0.4 = ?\) (Give your answer as a decimal.)
solution:
\(40\%\) of a number is 20. Multiply both the dividend and divisor by 10 to make the divisor an integer without changing the quotient:
\[
20 \div 0.4 = 200 \div 4 = 50.
\]
The number is 50. Written as a decimal, the answer is \(50.0\).
